p-oliverspencer-15822780727679.d:
The Westerman Navy Westbury Suit is a beautiful iteration of our tailoring principles, merging a polished aesthetic with a relaxed, effortless character. Crafted from a soft and lightweight cotton and wool blend, this ensemble features a subtle textural finish in a rich navy tone, making it a versatile choice for the modern wardrobe.
The Westbury jacket is a single-breasted two-button style defined by its broad notch lapels. We have kept the construction completely unstructured to afford a fluid feel and a natural drape that gets better and better with wear. It is a piece that brings a quiet sense of formality through the week, yet feels easy enough to style casually over the weekend.
Completing the suit, our signature Fishtail trousers feature a classic V-shaped cut in the rear of the waistband for a comfortable, forgiving fit. Modern and flat-fronted, they taper gradually from the mid-thigh to create a sharp, clean profile. Whether worn together as a relaxed summer suit or styled as distinct separates, this navy combination will do you proud on any occasion.

p-oliverspencer-15762863980927.d: The Atlanta Long Sleeve Shirt is cut in a loose fit, designed to bring a relaxed, nonchalant shape to autumn dressing. Worn on its own with seasonal trousers, or layered casually over a T-shirt for a more relaxed approach to autumn styling, its a versatile seasonal staple that brings a tonne of texture and tactility to your fits.
